{"metadata":{"description":"🥧 Developer-first terminal coding agent rebuilt on Cordis (v4.0.1) microkernel with an "Everything is a plugin" architecture. 100% Pi parity & marketplace compatible.","id":"gh:1339369325","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"pi-cordis","slug":"civaapple-alt/pi-cordis","topics":["ai-agent","coding-agent","cordis","dsh-plugin","earendil-pi","tui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"🥧 Developer-first terminal coding agent rebuilt on Cordis (v4.0.1) microkernel with an "Everything i"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"s a plugin" architecture. 100% Pi parity & marketplace compatible."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# Pi-Cordis"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"Pi-Cordis is a thin, plugin-oriented Cordis control plane for the Pi terminal coding agent. It keeps"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" Pi's TUI, agent loop, model adapters, session behavior, and core tools as the data plane, then adds"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" reversible policy and composition seams around them."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"中文 · Architecture notes · Plugin guide"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Position in the ecosystem"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Pi** remains the product data plane. Pi-Cordis does not fork or reimplement its terminal UI or a"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"gent loop.
- **Cordis** supplies the IoC container, scoped fibers, typed events, and reversible effe"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"cts. Pi-Cordis consumes the official public `@deepseek-ai/cordis` package directly.
- **DeepSeek Har"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"ness (DSH)** is an architectural influence, not a runtime dependency. Pi-Cordis adopts capability se"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ams, explicit injection, scoped composition, and reversible side effects without importing the DSH a"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ection, scoped composition, and reversible side effects without importing the DSH application stack."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"This boundary is deliberate: Pi-Cordis is useful when a Pi user needs runtime policy and scenario co"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"mposition, but does not need a second agent kernel."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Design rules"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"1. **Keep the data plane upstream.** Model I/O, the coding loop, TUI rendering, and built-in tools s"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"tay in Pi.
2. **Registrations are reversible effects.** Tools, commands, filters, prompts, and liste"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ners return disposers and are owned by Cordis fibers.
3. **Profiles alter capability surfaces, not p"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"roduct identity.** Switching a profile disposes its exact fibers and synchronizes the tools visible "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"to Pi.
4. **Security interception is serial.** Tool calls, including calls made inside PTC, pass thr"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"ough the same Cordis safety pipeline.
5. **Do not report simulated work as success.** Unimplemented "},{"id":"p10s7","text":"Subagent, SSH, and Compaction prototypes are private and absent from publishable profiles.
6. **Desi"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"gn from the review moment.** Complete artifacts stay readable before approval, cancellation stops th"},{"id":"p10s9","text":"e workflow, dangerous mutations require visible confirmation, and failures or degraded execution rem"},{"id":"p10s10","text":"angerous mutations require visible confirmation, and failures or degraded execution remain explicit."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Profiles and Plan state"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### `default`"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The default Profile keeps Pi's ordinary tool presentation and mounts eight verified enhancements: `s"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"afety-gate`, `git-guard`, `rules-injector`, `todo-tracker`, `output-truncator`, `ask-question`, `btw"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"`, and `terminal-notifier`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### `ptc`"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The PTC Profile adds `code-mode` and presents raw tools through the generated `pi` SDK and `run_code"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"`. Its Worker provides timeout and failure isolation, not a permission sandbox; nested calls still c"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ross Cordis interception."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Plan"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Plan is per-session collaboration state, not a Profile. The stable root-scoped `plan-mode` plugin co"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ntributes `/plan`, `/plan <request>`, `/plan off`, and `exit_plan_mode` in both Profiles. `/plan <re"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"quest>` enters Plan and immediately submits that text under its read-only policy. Entering or leavin"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"g Plan does not remount plugins or change the tool schema. While active, Plan guidance and mutation "},{"id":"p17s5","text":"guardrails apply equally to ordinary and PTC tool calls.
## Quick start from source"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Requirements: Node.js 22.19 or newer and pnpm."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The command names are `picds` and `picordis`; the project never claims `pi` on `PATH`. User data liv"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"es under `~/.picds/agent/`. Pi-Cordis control-plane files (Profiles and spill output) use `.picds/`,"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" with `.pi/` fallback only where explicitly documented. Pi-owned project resources such as prompt te"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"mplates continue to follow Pi's upstream locations."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Package and plugin status"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The publishable graph contains thirteen capability plugins plus `@pi-cordis/profiles` and `@pi-cordi"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"s/core`. Each publishable package emits ESM JavaScript and declaration files into `dist/`, declares "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"explicit exports, and passes `publint`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Private prototypes are kept out of the release dependency graph:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- `plugin-subagent`: session allocation existed, but no agent driver executed the delegated task.
- "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"`plugin-ssh-delegator`: returned simulated output instead of creating an SSH transport.
- `plugin-co"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"ntext-compactor`: emitted an event without connecting to Pi's native compaction operation."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"They must not become public again until they have a real driver, failure semantics, lifecycle tests,"},{"id":"p25s2","text":" and end-to-end verification."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Development and release gates"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"CI runs `release:check` on Ubuntu, Windows, and macOS with Node 22.19. A release is not considered c"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ross-platform verified until that matrix passes."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Repository layout"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The service API documentation is under packages/core/docs/cordis/services."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Current maturity"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The repository has a reproducible package pipeline and verified local Windows tarball installation. "},{"id":"p33s2","text":"Interactive real-model TUI behavior and the three-platform CI matrix remain release evidence, not as"},{"id":"p33s3","text":"sumptions; consult the latest CI run before publishing."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"License: MIT"}],"truncated":false}
